description: Plantilla .NET 10 de Clean Architecture con Dapper. Auth completa (JWT + refresh rotativo + logout instantáneo con blocklist), roles dinámicos con permisos por endpoint, modo cookie/header configurable, account lockout, CSRF, password reset, email verification, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, health checks, audit log, FluentValidation, rate limiting, módulos auto-registrables, API versioning, Docker.
title: Dapper Clean Architecture Modular Solution
